title: Session Hijacking - Understading Cookie-Based Authentication
content:
Session Hijacking
Difficulty: ⭐⭐⭐ ☆ ☆
Category: Web Security
Estimated Reading Time: 20-30 minutes



⚠ Disclaimer
Had articale ghaykon educational only.
L’objectif huwa tfham kifash session hijacking ktkhdm o kifash les sites ki9dro ys3bo exploit dialha o kifash nta thmi rask mnha. 


IntroductionKamlin knst3mlo Discord, Instagram, Facebook, Gmail…
Fash katdir login awel mra, kaytlbo mnk:

Username / Email
Password

Walakin mn moraha katwli katdkhol normal bla may3awdo ytlbo mnk password kol mra.
So… kifash hadchi kaykhdm?
Server kaydir creation lwahed Session katremplaci process dial login b user/password.
Had Session katkon linked b wahed identifier smito:
Session ID
O ghaliban had Session ID katsajal f Cookie.

Example:stateDiagram-v2    [*] --> Login    Login --> CredentialsSubmitted    CredentialsSubmitted --> ServerVerification    ServerVerification --> LoginFailed    ServerVerification --> SessionCreated    LoginFailed --> Login    SessionCreated --> SetCookie    SetCookie --> BrowserStoresCookie    BrowserStoresCookie --> Authenticated    Authenticated --> [*]

Note: Kayn bzaf dial vulnerabilities o misconfigurations li t9dr tw9a3 f had lmarahil. Ghadi nhdro 3lihom b tafsil mn b3d. 

Daba bash tfham had process mzyan, aju ndiroha step by step.

Nta katktb Username + Password.
Server kayverify credentials.
Ila kano valid, kaycreate Session.
Kayrj3 Session ID b Set-Cookie.
Browser kay7fed Cookie.
Browser kayb9a kaytsift Cookie automatically f ay request.

donc haka mktb9ash kdir login fkol mra tbghi dir chi haja f site ex: instagram. kib9a 3a9l 3lik bdek session.

Session HijackingServer kayb9a 3arfk b Session ID, machi b password.
Nakhdu Pinterest mtalan 
Browser dialk kaykhli ghir:
_pinterest_sess=TWc9PSYyOWRlc1JkM2w1YVloRTFVWFIycWZFN1dFdmdmL2RmdWo2.........TzZ3PQ==

Note: Mashi darori tkon haka session= abdwa (plaintext) f real world Usually opaque/random identifiers. o ta key name mashi darori ykon session y9dr ykon _pinterest_sess bhal f pinterest y9dr ykon smia akhra fsite akhur.

Ama server huwa li kayrbt had Session b information dialk.
Bhal:

Username
Email
Role
Permissions
Login Time
Expiration
…

Hadchi kaykhtalef mn server l server 3la 7sab implementation.
Donc password beh kndiro create Session.
Mn b3dha Session hia li katwli lkey dial login.
Hna kiji lconcept dial:
 Session Hijacking
Attacker mam7tajch y3rf:

Password
Email
Username

O f b3d scenarios ta MFA t9dr mat3awnch ila kant Session ba9a valid.
3lach?
Hit server kaychof ghir:
Cookie:session=abc123

Ila had Session ba9a valid…
Server kaygol:

“Hada user deja authenticated.”

Wakha li kaydir request ma3ndo ta 3ala9a b owner dial l’account.
flowchart LRA[Victim Logged In]--> B[Browser Stores Session Cookie]B--> C[Attacker Steals Cookie]C--> D[Attacker Imports Cookie]D--> E[Attacker Sends Requests]E--> F[Server Accepts Session]F--> G[Authenticated as Victim]

Hada huwa Session Hijacking.

But…How Can Cookies Be Stolen?Kayn bzaf dial toro9 bash hadchi ywa9e3.
Mn ashharhom:

Stealers

Stealersflowchart TDA[User Logs In]--> B[Browser Stores Session Cookie]B--> C[Info-Stealer Malware Runs]C--> D[Searches Browser Cookie Databases]D--> E[Extracts Valid Session Cookies]E--> F[Sends Cookies to Attacker Server]F--> G[Attacker Imports Cookie]G--> H[Website Accepts Session]H--> I[Authenticated as Victim]


Browser Extensions:%%{init: {  "theme":"base",  "themeVariables":{    "primaryColor":"transparent",    "primaryBorderColor":"#64d2ff",    "primaryTextColor":"#e8e8e8",    "lineColor":"#64d2ff",    "textColor":"#e8e8e8",    "mainBkg":"transparent",    "nodeBorder":"#64d2ff"  }}}%%flowchart TDStart([User Installs Extension])Start --> Verify{Trusted Source?}Verify -->|Official Store & Verified| Safe[Lower Risk]Verify -->|Unknown / Fake| PermissionPermission{High-Risk Permissions Granted?}Permission -->|No| Stop[Limited Access]Permission -->|Yes| Cookie[Browser Cookies Accessible]Cookie --> Send[Cookies Sent to Attacker]Send --> Import[Cookie Imported]Import --> Login[Authenticated Session]


XSS%%{init: {  "theme":"base",  "themeVariables":{    "primaryColor":"transparent",    "primaryBorderColor":"#64d2ff",    "primaryTextColor":"#e8e8e8",    "lineColor":"#64d2ff",    "textColor":"#e8e8e8",    "mainBkg":"transparent",    "nodeBorder":"#64d2ff"  }}}%%flowchart TDA[Victim Opens Vulnerable Page]--> B{XSS Exists?}B -->|No| C[Normal Page]B -->|Yes| D[Injected JavaScript]D --> E{HttpOnly Cookie?}E -->|Yes| F[Cookie Protected]E -->|No| G[Read document.cookie]G --> H[Send Cookie]H --> I[Session Hijacked]


Session Replayflowchart LRA[Victim Visits Website]--> B[Session Replay Script Loads]B--> C[Records User Activity]C--> D[Mouse Movement]C--> E[Keyboard Input]C--> F[Scrolling]C--> G[Clicks]D--> H[Replay Server]E--> HF--> HG--> HH--> I[Session Recording]

Session Replay hiya technique kikhdmo beha bzf dial websites bash y9dro ychofok kifash katst3ml site dialhom.
B simple words, script load m3a page o kaybda record l interaction dialk:

Mouse movement
Clicks
Scroll
Keyboard input (ila ma tfilterach)
Page navigation
Screen size
Browser information

Mn b3d had data katsift l replay server fin owner dial site y9dr y3awd ychof session dialk almost b7al video.

Session Replay mashi attack. Hadi feature katst3mlha companies b7al Hotjar, FullStory, Microsoft Clarity… bash y7sno UX.(User Experience)

Lmochkil kaybda ila:

Sensitive fields ma tmaskawch.
Password fields tsajlo b ghalat.
Personal information (Email, Phone, Address…) ttsift l third-party.
Replay scripts ykon feh misconfiguration.

Dak sa3a replay mab9ash ghir analytics, wla privacy risk.
💡 Modern Session Replay providers kaydiro masking l password fields, credit cards, w sensitive inputs. Walakin implementation dial website hia li kat7dd wash had protection khdama mzyan ola la.

Intercepts Traffic .-> V    A -. Reads Session Cookie .-> S    A -->|Reuse Cookie| S    S -->|Authenticated Session| A

Note
MITM (Man-In-The-Middle) kan momkin ykon sabab f Session Hijacking ila website mazal khdam b HTTP. Hit requests katmchi unencrypted, attacker ila kan f nafs network y9dr ychof traffic w ila l9a Session Cookie valid y9dr yst3mloha.
Lyoum, had lattack wla s3ib bzf m3a HTTPS (TLS) hit requests katkon encrypted, w attacker ma y9drch y9ra Cookie ghir b sniffing. Walakin ila website ma mconfigurach mzyan ola kayn downgrade/misconfiguration, lkhatar mazal kayn.


DetectionSometimes Websites ki9dro ychako.
Examples:

Sudden IP change
Different Country
Different Browser
Impossible Travel
Unusual Activity
Multiple Active Sessions

hadchi li kikhlihom ydiro Force Logout or Require MFA Again

Blue Team PerspectiveDaba 3rfna kifash attacker y9dr ywsl l Session Cookie.
Walakin… kifash defenders y9dro ys3bo hadchi?
Session Hijacking ma t9drch tmna3ha 100%, walakin t9dr ts3bha bzf ila kan implementation mzyan.
Secure Cookie AttributesCookie khasha tkon mconfigura b had attributes:

HttpOnly
Secure
SameSite

HttpOnlySet-Cookie: session=abc123; HttpOnly

Kaymn3 JavaScript mn laccess l Cookie.
Hadchi kay7mi mn bzaf dial XSS scenarios.

SecureSet-Cookie: session=abc123; Secure

Cookie matsiftch ila kan request b HTTP.
Katsift ghir m3a HTTPS.

SameSiteSet-Cookie: session=abc123; SameSite=Lax

Kay9ll mn Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attacks.
Options:

Strict
Lax
None


Session ExpirationSession matkhasshach tb9a valid forever.
Best Practice:

Short expiration for sensitive accounts(Banks).
Invalidate Session after logout.
Rotate Session ID after successful login.


Session RotationMni user kaydir login successfully…
Matb9ach tst3ml nafs Session ID.
Create wa7da jdida.
Old Session↓Destroyed↓New Random Session ID

Hadchi kay9ll mn Session Fixation attacks.

Re-AuthenticationSensitive actions b7al:

Change Password
Change Email
Delete Account
View Recovery Codes

Khas ytalbo:

Password Again

or

MFA Again


Device & Session MonitoringModern websites kikhdmo 3la detection dial suspicious activity.
Examples:

Impossible Travel
Sudden Country Change
Different Browser Fingerprint
New Device
ASN Change
Multiple Active Sessions

Ila chi haja bant suspicious…
Website kidir:

Force Logout
Invalidate Session
Require MFA Again
Notify User


User AwarenessNta as a User khask thawl tb3d 3la had lhwayj.
Avoid:

Installing random extensions.
Downloading cracked software.
Running unknown executables.
Using HTTP websites.
Reusing infected browsers.

Always:

Enable MFA.
Logout from shared devices.
Keep browser updated.
Review active sessions periodically.


Final ThoughtsSession Hijacking ma kat3nich attacker khaso y3rf password.
F bzaf dial cases…
Session Cookie katkon kafiya bash website y3tabrk authenticated.
3liha security dial Session management hiya wa7da mn aham l7wayj f ay web application.
Strong Password, MFA, HTTPS, Secure Cookies, Session Rotation, Detection logic…
Kamlin kaykhdmo m3a b3dyathom bash ys3bo l7ayat 3la attacker.
Remember:

Authentication proves who you are.


Session proves that you’ve already been authenticated.

Ila Session ttsra9…
Server ma y9drch y3rf wash nta howa l’owner wla attacker, ila makanch kayn detection logic w secure session management.

💡 Fun Fact
Bzf dial Infostealer malwares li kaytba3o f dark web ma kaybi3och passwords, kaybi3o Active Browser Sessions.
